notes: The counterweight to CI-2026-08-03-READINESS-SCOPED-TO-OBJECT-001. The freeze half of this rule is CI-2026-08-03-FREEZE-POPULATION-DISCLOSURE-001, which has no canary yet.

canaries.assertion: The full population (Discovered / Admitted / Excluded with warnings / Manual exceptions / Refused / Assigned to crystal) rides every surface AND every partial-progress receipt; canaried in both directions.

statement: A governed artifact may not pass by silently shrinking the evidentiary population it was assessed over.

occurrences.defect: Exception isolation, taken alone, lets a system quietly reduce the corpus until readiness passes. "Exception isolation without population disclosure is a worse failure than the batch-blocking it replaces."
